verses.1: The song of praise to David, who was the servant of the LORD. May it be said by us: “O Israel!”
verses.2: May the Lord have mercy on us, so that there would be a man who can rise up against us.
verses.3: Then they live in their own nests, with their beaks stuck in their mouths.
verses.4: Then, the waters that flooded us became a blessing upon our souls.
verses.5: Then, those bitter waters rushed over our souls.
verses.6: Blessed is Jehovah, who did not give us over to their hands.
verses.7: Our souls, like threads, were pulled out of the depths of sorrow. The pit has been filled, and we have been rescued.
verses.8: Help us in the name of Jehovah, who creates heaven and earth.
